purpose: Measure a short accuracy learning curve after preserving complete original examples; no parameter scaling or automatic full-pass run.
selected_budget_evidence: untruncated-gpu-probe-v1; larger budgets remain optional and untested
coverage: New exact traversal beginning at the best checkpoint; old unique coverage is unknown. Commit consumed original row IDs and full token counts only after successful updates.
generation: Strict greedy, original official 1919-question order, unchanged evaluation caps for comparability.
data: All 60 verified original shards, full-coverage eligible index, no transformed or new targets.
artifact_policy: Save and verify every checkpoint and predictions on Drive before export; bot-score all four retained checkpoints.
evaluation: Run held-out executed-answer accuracy and execution-failure counts at each retained checkpoint; report the trajectory against the parent. Public scores are recorded separately. This continuation is not a causal comparison of data traversal versus truncation.
extension_policy: No automatic longer run. Review the complete trajectory and data receipts before continuation; no claim that all rows were trained until a full-pass receipt exists.
